sources.design: Systematic review,48 studies/1902 primary AC OA shoulders
sources.population: Clinical/radiological primary AC OA; some concomitant cuff/impingement pathology.
sources.comparator: One PT-only cohort; one PT-versus-surgery study with impingement; most injection/surgery studies.
sources.outcomes: Positive within-study changes; heterogeneity precluded meta-analysis; PT evidence sparse.
sources.followUp: Mean approximately28.5 months across heterogeneous studies; PT cohort six months.
sources.uncertainty: Single military PT cohort short follow-up; not isolated primary-OA randomized exercise evidence.
sources.harms: No specific exercise injury incidence established.
sources.limitations: Surgery and injection improvements cannot prescribe a particular strengthening/stretch dose.

sources.design: Prospective uncontrolled single cohort,15 enrolled/13 completed
sources.population: Injection-confirmed nonacute AC pain, mean41,85%male, military setting; four normal radiographs.
sources.coInterventions: Manual therapy across AC/other joints; later home ROM/resistance exercises.
sources.outcomes: SPADI improved25.9 points at4weeks/29.8 at6months; not isolated exercise efficacy.
sources.uncertainty: Small uncontrolled mixed-radiographic cohort; primary OA attribution indirect.
sources.harms: No formal adverse-event count found; completers no additional care/activity reduction/increased medication.
sources.limitations: Study delaying strength to4weeks does not establish early-strength contraindication.

protocol.execution: Therapist-chosen painless passive/assisted/active flexion, cane IR/chest stretch/horizontal adduction; later tubing strength, wall push-up≤90° elbow flexion, scapular retraction/protraction progression from all fours to incline to regular push-up.
protocol.dose: Manual sessions30min twice weekly3weeks; no individual exercise repetitions/holds in Appendix B.
protocol.supervision: Experienced therapists; home instruction/pictures and possible booster sessions.
protocol.progression: No strength/self-mobilization before4week visit in protocol; scapular progression all fours→incline→regular push-up.
protocol.stoppingRules: Appendix B: well tolerated and painless exercise; no universal pain-damage threshold.

locations: Appendix B > List of Therapeutic Exercises (PDF p. 80)
